reviews.body: Thanks @pcbeingused333 — appreciate the quick follow-up on the `top_p` default handling and the request-body tests. Merging this so the OpenAI default stays usable after today's gpt-3.5-turbo shutdown. We'll call out the model/cost change in the release notes.

comments.body: ****CLA Assistant Lite bot**** All contributors have signed the CLA  ✍️ ✅
I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA

Thanks! Confirmed the 2026-10-23 shutdown on OpenAI's deprecations page. Since gpt-5.6-terra is a reasoning model, could you check that a real Chat Completions call works with our default `temperature=1` / `top_p=1` (or drop `top_p` when it's the default)? We'll also note the cost/latency change in the release notes.

Thanks for checking the deprecation date. I did not call the real API, so I can't confirm a live request to gpt-5.6-terra; instead I made the request safe by construction: `top_p` is no longer sent when it has its default value (1), so the default config (`temperature=1`, `top_p=1`) sends only `temperature=1`. Any other `top_p` the user sets is still sent unchanged. The new test in `pkg/infra/ai/openai_test.go` checks the request body against a local test server for both cases, and fails without the change. The change is in the second commit of this PR.
